daily.today_energy: The universe is whispering that it's time to trust your gut instincts. Your analytical mind is sharp today, but don't overthink every detail—sometimes the vibes just hit different when you let yourself feel things.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a gentle reminder to show up authentically. Your people appreciate you most when you're being real, not when you're perfectly put together. That vulnerability? It's actually your superpower.
daily.career: Your attention to detail is about to pay off in ways you weren't expecting. Today's energy favors finishing what you started and speaking up in spaces where your voice matters. You've got valuable perspective—don't dim it.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance today. Maybe it's a walk outside, stretching, or just drinking enough water. Honor what feels good rather than what feels obligatory. Wellness is about listening, not forcing.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing in your house of reinvention, so expect some unexpected clarity about who you actually want to be. This week feels like permission to shed what no longer fits. Trust the plot twist.
weekly.love: Venus is giving soft energy, but also boundary energy. If you're coupled up, those real conversations hit different rn. Single? Someone's noticing your vibe. Don't dim it down for anyone.
weekly.career: Your creative problem-solving is literally unmatched this week. That project or idea you've been sitting on? The momentum is there. Put yourself out there without overthinking the optics.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness and consistency over intensity. Think sustainable routines that actually feel good, not punishing ones. Sleep quality matters more than you think rn.
